title: Gaussian Normalized Coordinates and Risk-Neutral CDF Deformations
abstract: arXiv:2609.14212v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Normalized implied-volatility coordinates reveal no-arbitrage structure that is less transparent in strike space. This paper centers on a single quantity that gives those coordinates a direct probabilistic interpretation.

translated_title: 高斯归一化坐标与风险中性累积分布函数形变
translated_abstract: 归一化隐含波动率坐标揭示了无套利结构，而这种结构在行权价空间中较难清晰呈现。本文聚焦于一个单一量，该量为这些坐标提供了直接的概率解释。
tldr: 本文通过引入一个单一量，为归一化隐含波动率坐标赋予了直接的概率解释，从而更清晰地揭示期权定价中的无套利结构。
en_tdlr: This paper centers on a single quantity that gives normalized implied-volatility coordinates a direct probabilistic interpretation, making the no-arbitrage structure more transparent than in strike space.
